items.reason: Describes handling nil or blank default locales during fallback-chain construction, distinct from missing fallback catalogs or incorrect cache keys.
Describes inconsistent string/symbol locale representation affecting matching and load tracking. Neither golden issue concerns locale normalization.
Describes a claimed synchronization problem in loaded-locale tracking, not missing fallback-chain loading outside controllers. load_locale already locks and rechecks membership.
Describes the same unloaded fallback catalogs in jobs and mailers caused by ensuring the fallback chain only in the controller.
Describes the same cache-key omission of site-dependent fallback context, causing incorrect translations across sites or after default-locale changes.
Describes regex interpolation of unvalidated locale values loading unintended files. This is distinct from both golden issues.
